analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 49.2 continues in neutral zone; while up from 34.9 five days ago, confirmation of exiting oversold is insufficient. MACD histogram improved from -2.7303 to 1.0511, but it's too early to confirm a trend reversal. ADX at 23.2 indicates an early stage of trend formation, and the -DI (27.9) being higher than +DI (22.3) suggests residual downward pressure. Volume ratio of 0.35 for five consecutive days indicates a lack of conviction in price direction. Within the 70-day 'hold' stance, a -1.1% return has been recorded. The current price of $345.13 is below SMA20 ($347.16) and above EMA20 ($343.91), indicating sideways movement in the neutral zone. Price action is confined between swing support at $343.29 and resistance at $347.61.
